verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so hardware-accelerator backends are a fair question for it. The evidence describes only CPU execution on phones, wearables and desktops ('no GPU'). Community reports say the GPU isn't used for inference, and nothing documents a plugin system for TPUs, Gaudi or other specialized accelerators.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on specialized accelerators like TPUs or Gaudi through plugin support
